Infantry (Infantry) is a branch of the Army and Marine Corps that conducts ground combat with light weapons and dismounted maneuvers. It is responsible for offense, defense, reconnaissance, vigilance and field survival tasks. It relies on physical fitness, shooting, tactics and team coordination to play its role on the battlefield. It is the basic combat unit of the armed forces.

paragraphs: Life in the army is the trinity of "discipline + training + mission": you go out for drills in the early morning, practice shooting, tactics and physical fitness according to the schedule during the day, and go out to the field for training every now and then. In the days when there are no wars, training is the main business - making every action perfect is the meaning of the infantry's existence.

In a word: practice your physical marksmanship and tactics well, and be ready to perform ground operations and missions at any time. Before joining the army, think clearly about your motivation and physical ability. The military can temper people and provide protection, but it is also a high-intensity disciplined life; it allows children to exercise physical fitness and understand service policies in advance, so that they can develop more if they are admitted to military academies or take the path of technical arms.

During his service, he took the initiative to learn information equipment, drone operation and communication skills, and participated in training and military competitions to perform meritorious service. Decommissioning transformation is a systematic project: using decommissioning resettlement policies, vocational skills training and academic qualification improvement plans, the discipline, leadership and equipment skills learned by the troops are transferred to security, firefighting, construction machinery and other directions.

Retired military personnel are a high-quality recruitment pool: they have strong discipline, strong resistance to pressure, and good execution ability. Giving retired soldiers clear skills certification channels and career plans during recruitment is more effective in retaining people than simply "emotional recruitment".

The most unforgettable thing in this industry is the "comrades": the brothers who walked five kilometers together, slept together in the wild, and won the mission together in drills. This is a relationship that cannot be replaced by any colleagues in the workplace. The discipline and pressure resistance provided by the army will become the foundation of your life.

This industry provides "experiences you can't find anywhere else": the starry sky seen during outdoor training, the extreme limit after a five-kilometer cross-country trip, the friendship of fellow comrades - the body and will honed by the army are the foundation for a lifetime.
If you are willing to trade a few years of youth for your skills and a group of brothers, infantry will be the most important experience in many people's lives.
